newsitem.title: UK: UK to send more businessmen to overseas embassies.
newsitem.headline: UK to send more businessmen to overseas embassies.

text.p: LONDON, June 10 (Reuter - The government is planning to send more businessmen to its overseas embassies in an effort to boost British exports, Foreign Secretary Robin Cook said on Tuesday.

He told parliament he was exploring with Lord David Simon, minister for trade and competitiveness, how to increase exchanges between business and the Foreign Office to make sure diplomats both in Britain and abroad can tap their expertise.

"I hope to be making an announcement on an increase in the number of businessmen on short-term secondments to our posts abroad before the House (of Commons) rises for the summer," Cook said at question time.
